# pantechdynamics_access_policy (Resource)

An access policy: statements that allow or deny actions on resources, attached to members or teams with pantechdynamics_access_policy_attachment. Write the statements as statement blocks, or as policy_json (for example from pantechdynamics_access_policy_document); set exactly one. Statements are compared by meaning, so reordering actions or writing a CIDR another way does not show a change. Pantech's managed policies (pol_pantech_*) cannot be managed here: read them with the pantechdynamics_access_policy data source. At most 100 policies per organization; owners and admins only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Recipe: staging operators. Members of the team may restart and resize
# staging machines, from the office network only, and may never delete a
# production one (a matching deny always wins, even for admins).
resource "pantechdynamics_team" "staging_operators" {
  name = "Staging operators"
}

resource "pantechdynamics_access_policy" "staging_operators" {
  name        = "staging-operators"
  description = "Restart and resize staging machines"

  statement {
    sid       = "RestartStaging"
    effect    = "allow"
    actions   = ["instances:Read", "instances:Start", "instances:Stop", "instances:Reboot", "instances:Resize"]
    resources = ["name:staging-*"]

    conditions = {
      source_ip = ["102.89.0.0/16"]
    }
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "NoProdDeletes"
    effect    = "deny"
    actions   = ["instances:Delete"]
    resources = ["name:prod-*"]
  }
}

resource "pantechdynamics_access_policy_attachment" "staging_operators" {
  policy_id      = pantechdynamics_access_policy.staging_operators.id
  principal_type = "team"
  principal_id   = pantechdynamics_team.staging_operators.id
}

# The same kind of policy from JSON instead of blocks (set one or the other):
resource "pantechdynamics_access_policy" "nothing_without_mfa" {
  name = "no-deletes-without-mfa"
  policy_json = jsonencode({
    statements = [{
      sid       = "DenyDeletesWithoutMFA"
      effect    = "deny"
      actions   = ["*:Delete"]
      resources = ["*"]
      conditions = {
        mfa = false # on a deny: applies when the request lacks MFA
      }
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name unique in the organization: 1 to 64 letters, digits, spaces, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit. Names starting with pantech_ are reserved. Changes in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A note for yourself, at most 255 characters. Defaults to "".
- `policy_json` (String) The statements as JSON, {"statements": [...]}, instead of statement blocks. When you use statement blocks, this shows them as JSON, in a normal form (sorted, de-duplicated).
- `statement` (Block List) One statement, 1 to 20 per policy, unless policy_json is set. A matching deny wins over any allow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--statement))

### Read-Only

- `attachment_count` (Number) How many members and teams the policy is attached to.
- `created_at` (String) When the policy was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the policy, starting with pol_.
- `version` (Number) Version of the policy. Every update is sent with it as If-Match, so a change made elsewhere since the last refresh is refused instead of overwritten.

<a id="nestedblock--statement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `statement`

Required:

- `actions` (Set of String) 1 to 50 actions, such as "instances:Stop", or wildcards in the service or the verb: "instances:*", "*:Read", "*". The pantechdynamics_iam_actions data source lists every action.
- `effect` (String) "allow" or "deny". A matching deny always wins, for admins and members alike; owners are never limited by a policy.
- `resources` (Set of String) 1 to 50 resources: "*", a resource id such as "vm_01JD...", or "name:<pattern>" matched against the resource's name ("*" any run of characters, "?" one character, case-insensitive), such as "name:staging-*".

Optional:

- `conditions` (Attributes) Conditions that must all hold for the statement to apply. Leave it out for none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--statement--conditions))
- `sid` (String) An optional label for the statement, unique within the policy: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '_' or '-'.

<a id="nestedatt--statement--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `statement.conditions`

Optional:

- `mfa` (Boolean) true: the statement applies only to a session signed in with MFA, never to an API key. false on a deny: the deny applies only without MFA ("nothing without MFA"). false on an allow is the same as leaving it out.
- `source_ip` (Set of String) The request must come from one of these 1 to 20 IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR blocks (a single address is its /32 or /128).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# One of your organization's policies is imported by its id. Pantech-managed
# policies (pol_pantech_*) cannot be imported: read them with the
# pantechdynamics_access_policy data source.
terraform import pantechdynamics_access_policy.staging_operators pol_06ggf9abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw
```
